The '''Bespin 2017 Kick Off''' was a free four-game tournament on 29 October 2016 at Legacy Games, 15086 Claret Ave, Rosemount, Minnesota, organized by [[Mark Walseth]].<ref name="kickann">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1068834#p1068834 Bespin 2017 Kick Off], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 October 2016). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122223043/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1070258.html Internet Archive].</ref> [[Bryan Mischke]] won, and [[Scott Morgan]] won the random cube spot.<ref name="kickres">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1070258#p1070258 Results], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 October 2016). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122223043/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1070258.html Internet Archive].</ref>
